Pregnant Woman Gives Up The Seat She Just Asked A Teen For
description:
A pregnant woman in a yellow dress tapped a teen in headphones and pointed to her belly to ask for his seat.
He stood up right away and she sat down. Then she noticed an elderly man with a cane struggling to stay on his feet beside her, so she smiled, rose again, and gestured for him to take the seat she had just been given.
The woman who needed a seat most gave it to the one who needed it more.
